home.title: Your neighborhood diner.
home.lead: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and the in-between. They print: come in, sit down, get ready to eat.
home.heroAlt: A Wellington Diner burger and fries.
home.hoursLead: As printed on their home page. Their schema lists the same window but skips Monday — we print the seven-day board they show.
home.menuLead: A few plates from the full board — hashes, bennies, burgers, mac. Tax extra. Prices may change.
home.challengeLead: 40 minutes or it's $49.99. Oreo shake, three Mac Daddy burgers, double homie poutine. No splitting, no take-home.
home.challengeAlt: Beard Meets Food at The Wellington Diner with the Mac Daddy challenge.
home.photosLead: Photos they publish on the live site — the storefront, the plates, the board.
home.altStorefront: The Wellington Diner storefront on Wellington Street West, with a hot rod parked out front.
home.altPlates: A Wellington Diner server with burgers, mac, poutine, and onion rings.
home.altBenny: Eggs Benny with peppers, hollandaise, and homies at The Wellington Diner.
home.altStacked: A stacked Wellington Diner burger with onion rings and sauce.
home.altClub: A stacked club sandwich at The Wellington Diner.

menu.title: Menu
menu.lead: Served daily. Breakfast all day. Every priced dish from their live menus page, plus weekly specials as printed. Wix extras (shake flavours, egg style) are modifiers, not separate dishes.
menu.asOf: Snapshot of wellingtondiner.com/menus, 23 August 2026. Tax extra. Prices may change.
menu.allergens: Allergies and substitutions: ask the kitchen. We do not invent an allergen chart they do not print.
menu.note: Prices exclude tax and may change. Copied from wellingtondiner.com/menus. In-house specials have their own rules.

specials.title: Specials
specials.lead: As printed on their menu. In-house only where they say so.
specials.challengeCaption: They credit Beard Meets Food for making it famous. Channel name on YouTube is BeardMeatsFood — Adam Moran — in their booth for the Mac Daddy.
specials.challengeWatch: Watch the YouTube video they credit
specials.challengeAlt: Beard Meets Food (BeardMeatsFood) at The Wellington Diner with the Mac Daddy challenge: burgers, poutine, and a shake.

hours.title: Hours
hours.lead: Come visit us — daily 8 am to 9 pm on the home page.
hours.schema: Their Google schema also says 08:00–21:00, but it lists Sunday and Tuesday–Saturday only (no Monday). We do not drop Monday when the page itself prints it.
hours.delivery: Third-party apps sometimes show different close times. We print the diner’s own hours.

about.title: About
about.lead: The Wellington Diner is a traditional diner in Ottawa. Family since 2015. Fresh ingredients, casual, family-friendly — as they write it.
about.blend: They write a blend of locally-sourced products and classic dishes.
about.address: 1385 Wellington Street West, Ottawa, ON K1Y 2X1 — as their schema prints. Some maps use K1Y 2X2. We use the postal they publish.
about.windows: Their storefront photo shows “wifi friendly” in the windows. We do not publish a password or a policy they did not write.
about.challenge: The Mac Daddy challenge lives on its own page on their site.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Reservations are taken by phone. Please call to book. Their Wix form is for messages, not a table hold. We do not process reservations here.
contact.delivery: DoorDash delivers this diner. App hours can close earlier than the in-house 9 pm board. Tables are still by phone — DoorDash is not a reservation.

host.title: Booth host
host.subtitle: Website helper — not staff at the diner
host.tapSound: Browser blocked the voice. Tap Sound on.

host.hello: Hey! Pull up a stool. I can talk menu, hours, and how to book. I cannot hold a table — they take reservations by phone: (613) 798-7800.

host.fallback: I'm stuck on this side of the glass. Call (613) 798-7800 — I still cannot book a table.
